# Subway Seat for Alfred

A walnut window with a recessed search field; the selected result sits on a soft orange tint with its hotkey in orange. Theming Alfred needs the Powerpack.

[Alfred](https://www.alfredapp.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/alfred/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat.alfredappearance) | `double-click to import into Alfred` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.alfredappearance) | `double-click to import into Alfred` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.alfredappearance) | `double-click to import into Alfred` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Alfred Preferences → Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat under Appearance
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Alfred Preferences → Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat Tunnel.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat Tunnel under Appearance
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Alfred Preferences → Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat Enamel.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat Enamel under Appearance
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `double-click to import into Alfred`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
